messages:
marta: Evening handoff — I’m going off at 18:00 PT. Quick notes for the night shift:

marta: Current noisy signals to ignore unless they worsen:
• telemetry_sampler_errors (sporadic spikes in eu metrics aggregator) — alarm threshold firing ~30m windows, already annotated in dash.
• prefetcher_retries (p4 pool) — transient backoff after rollout, affecting <1% of requests.
• kv_client_latency_p50 bump on node-gpu-5 — observed during GC windows.

marta: What to actively watch for:
• encoder-pool saturation: if queue_length > 120 for >5m, open a PagerDuty and scale pool manually.
• autoscale backoff loops on dedicated capacity — look for repeated scale_down/scale_up events in the scaling audit.
• eu-region telemetry lag > 90s — this affects alerting accuracy; don’t silence until you confirm it’s regional.

leo: copied. Where's the scaler playbook?

marta: leo: /runbooks/scaling/encoder-pool.md (see manual scale steps and safe thresholds). Also quick cmds:
```
# check queue
curl -s http://metrics-api/internal/queue?pool=encoder-p4 | jq .queue_length
# manual scale
redwoodctl pool scale encoder-p4 --count=12 --reason="oncall-manual"
```

suri: FYI — I muted a noisy alert rule for prefetcher_retries (rule id: pref-retry-2026) at 17:40 because it was spamming and we have the rollout ticket open. Don’t unmute unless you confirm retries drop for 45m.

ops-bot: Alert muted: pref-retry-2026 by suri at 2026-03-17T17:40:12Z — reason: rollout noise.

james: Noted. Quick question: encoder-pool saturation page shows one host with CPU steal ~20% yesterday — could that be unrelated noisy telemetry?

marta: james: could be. If CPU steal persists across >2 hosts in the pool, treat it as underlying host contention and escalate to eng-infra. For a single host, drain it and drain alert will clear.

parul: Oncall handover checklist updated: I added a short section on how to check autoscale backoff logs (path: /var/logs/scaler/*.log) and the command to fetch recent scale events: `redwoodctl events --service=scaler --since=1h`

leo: small heads-up — there’s a new canary in eu-r1 that’s been serving lower throughput; it’s not in prod routing yet but watch tests/failures.any

marta: thanks. If canary fails healthchecks (5xx > 1% over 10m), revert the canary or route traffic away. Runbook link in console under Rollouts -> Canary Reverts.

suri: If anyone sees a flurry of telemetry_sampler_errors + pref-retry spikes together, assume it's the eu metrics aggregator regression and escalate to oncall-sre (pd). I’ve left an annotation on the main dashboard.

james: ack. I’ll be online until 19:30 PT in case anyone needs handoff follow-up.

leo: thanks marta — enjoy your evening. I’ll take first slice of the shift and ping if anything breaks. :wave:

parul: leaving a small note: I bumped the log retention for scaler logs to 48h for easier postmortem, so `redwoodctl logs --service=scaler --since=48h` should return more history now.

ops-bot: Handoff recorded: from marta to leo at 2026-03-17T18:00:01Z — watchers: eng-oncall, eng-sre.

leo: handing over to night team @suri/james at 19:30 PT. I’ll DM detailed notes if anything crops up.

suri: ack, will monitor encoder-pool and eu metrics.

james: ack.

marta: Saved the open items list in the shared doc: /docs/oncall/night-checklist.md — includes single-line remediation steps.

leo: closing the thread — quiet night expected but keep an eye on queue lengths. :thumbsup:
